وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً

Our Story

Written in the Stars

Some meetings are planned, and some are written long before we know. Ours began with a simple introduction between two families — and turned, over shared laughter and endless cups of chai, into a promise. This December, with the duas of everyone we love, that promise becomes forever. We would be honoured to have you beside us as it does.

— Ayesha & Ahmed
